features.name: Flyby
features.text: The death's head doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

features.name: Brain-Rending Bite
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the death's head's next turn.

features.name: Darklord Restoration
features.text: If Ankhtepot dies, he revives with all his Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Har'Akir.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.text: If Ankhtepot fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.text: Ankhtepot has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Ankhtepot makes four Negative Energy Burst attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Power Word Stun.

features.name: Negative Energy Burst
features.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) Necrotic damage.

features.name: Touch of Death
features.text: Ankhtepot touches one creature within 5 feet. If the creature has 80 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, it takes 52 (8d12) Necrotic damage.

features.name: Death Strike
features.text: Ankhtepot makes one Negative Energy Burst attack.

features.name: Hand of Fate
features.text: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Ankhtepot can see within 60 feet. Failure: 14 (2d8 + 5) Force damage, and the target is pushed or pulled up to 20 feet straight away or toward Ankhtepot. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Ankhtepot can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

features.name: Sands of Time
features.text: Ankhtepot teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from Ankhtepot at his destination space. Failure: 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, and the target magically ages 10 years. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Ankhtepot can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

features.name: Regional Effects
features.text:
Har'Akir is altered by Ankhtepot's presence, creating the following effects:

- **Blistering Sun.** Any outdoor area of Bright Light in Har'Akir is an area of extreme heat (see the Dungeon Master's Guide).
- **Closing the Borders.** While in his domain, Ankhtepot can close or open the borders to Har'Akir at will. While the borders are closed, whirling sands fill the Mists surrounding Har'Akir. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 2d6 Slashing damage.
- **Control Undead.** Undead of CR 5 or lower in Har'Akir have the Charmed condition and obey Ankhtepot's orders.

If Ankhtepot dies, these effects end immediately.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text: Ankhtepot casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

features.name: Darklord Restoration
features.text: If Azalin dies and his spirit jar remains intact, he revives with all his Hit Points in 2d10 days in the unoccupied space nearest his spirit jar. If Azalin's spirit jar is destroyed, he instead revives in 4d10 days in Castle Avernus in Darkon.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.text: If Azalin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Azalin makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch in any combination.

features.name: Eldritch Burst
features.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) Force damage.

features.name: Paralyzing Touch
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of Azalin's next turn.

features.name: Eldritch Teleport
features.text: Azalin teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see and makes one Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch attack.

features.name: Forbidden Knowledge
features.text: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 20, up to three creatures Azalin can see within 60 feet. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of Azalin's next turn. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Azalin can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

features.name: Regional Effects
features.text:
Darkon is altered by Azalin's presence, creating the following effects:

- **Closing the Borders.** While in his domain, Azalin can close or open the borders to Darkon at will. While the borders are closed, undead terrors fill the Mists surrounding Darkon. Whenever a creature enters the Mists, one Hostile Zombie Clot appears in a random unoccupied space within 30 feet of that creature.
- **Lord of the Dead.** While in his domain, Azalin can cast Clairvoyance, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as his Spellcasting action. When Azalin casts this spell in this way, he can place the sensor in any Undead in Darkon with an Intelligence of 6 or less, even if it is beyond 1 mile of Azalin. In addition, Azalin can speak through the Undead he placed the sensor in.
- **No Secrets.** Whenever a creature in Darkon casts a spell using a level 5+ spell slot, Azalin becomes aware of that creature's name and location. A Nondetection spell blocks this effect.

If Azalin dies, these effects end immediately.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text: Azalin casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

spellcasting.name: Siphon Spell
spellcasting.text: Azalin casts Counterspell in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. If the target creature fails its saving throw against this Counterspell, Azalin steals knowledge of the triggering spell. For 1 hour or until Azalin takes this Reaction again, Azalin can cast that spell once, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

features.name: Podling Link
features.text: The plant can see through and communicate telepathically with any of its podlings within 10 miles of it. When the plant dies, its podlings also die.

features.name: Rejuvenation
features.text: If the plant dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 days. This trait doesn't function if the plant is reduced to 0 Hit Points by Poison damage or its remains are sprinkled with salt.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The plant makes three Vine attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Entrapping Pod.

features.name: Vine
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 20 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of four vines.

features.name: Entrapping Pod
features.text:
Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Large or smaller creature the plant is grappling. Failure: The target is pulled into the plant's space, is no longer Grappled, and is trapped in the plant's pod. While trapped, the target has the Blinded and Paralyzed conditions, and it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the pod. After 2d4 hours, the trapped target dies, and if it was a Humanoid, a Bodytaker Podling resembling it emerges from the pod.

A creature outside the pod and within 5 feet of the plant can take an action to make a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the target is removed from the pod, falls in a space within 5 feet of the plant, and has the Prone condition. If the plant dies, the trapped target is no longer Blinded or Paralyzed and can escape from the pod using 5 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

features.name: Transfer Harm
features.text: Trigger: An attack roll hits the plant while a podling is within 5 feet of the plant. Response: The plant halves the damage it takes from that attack, and the podling takes the other half of the damage.

name: Bodytaker Podling
languages: Deep Speech plus one other language

features.name: Semblance of Life
features.text: The podling is a physical copy of a creature digested by a Bodytaker Plant. The podling has Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to pass as the digested creature. The podling melts into a slurry when it dies.

features.name: Slam
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Abduct
features.text: The boneless needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

features.name: Compression
features.text: The boneless can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

features.name: Smother
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and takes 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the boneless's turns. The boneless can smother only one creature at a time. While grappling a target, the boneless can't take this action again.

features.name: Unraveling Flesh
features.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature within 30 feet that can see the boneless. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition. Failure or Success: The boneless moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Brain in a Jar
languages: telepathy 60 ft. understands Common plus three other languages but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

features.name: Detect Intelligence
features.text: The brain magically senses the location of any creature within 300 feet of itself that has an Intelligence score of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.text: The brain has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The brain makes two Disrupting Burst attacks.

features.name: Disrupting Burst
features.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Psychic damage. The target can't take Reactions until the end of its next turn, and it has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Mind Blast
features.text: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of the brain's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text: The brain casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The carrion stalker makes two Tentacle attacks and one Stinger attack.

features.name: Tentacle
features.text:
Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and the carrion stalker attaches to the target. While attached, the carrion stalker can't make Tentacle attacks against other targets.

The carrion stalker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the carrion stalker as an action.

features.name: Stinger
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the carrion stalker is attached to the target), reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned in this way, the target is infested with a carrion stalker larva. If the target is still Poisoned in this way after 24 hours, the effect ends as the larva becomes a fully grown Carrion Stalker, which bursts from the target's chest and kills it.

features.name: Silver Needle
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a carrionette, it is subjected to the following effect. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target is cursed for 1 minute. Until the curse ends, the target has the Poisoned condition, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet.

features.name: Soul Swap
features.text:
Charisma Saving Throw: DC 11, one Humanoid the carrionette can see within 15 feet that is cursed by its Silver Needle. Failure: The carrionette possesses the target's body, and the target possesses the carrionette's body and has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour. While possessing another body, the carrionette and target retain their alignments; personalities; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; and languages known. They otherwise adopt the other creature's game statistics, though the target can't use this Soul Swap action.

The possession is undone if the target (while in the carrionette's body) deals damage to the carrionette (in the target's original body) with its Silver Needle. If either body is destroyed, both the carrionette and the target die.

features.name: Darklord Restoration
features.text: If Chakuna dies and her heart remains intact, she revives with all her Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Valachan. Chakuna's heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

features.name: Experienced Hunter
features.text: Difficult Terrain composed of undergrowth doesn't cost Chakuna extra movement.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.text: If Chakuna fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Chakuna makes three attacks, using Scratch or Barbed Spear in any combination. She can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

features.name: Bite (Panther or Hybrid Form Only)
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a werepanther under the DM's control and has 10 Hit Points (use the Weretiger stat block). Success: The target is immune to Chakuna's curse for 24 hours.

features.name: Scratch
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

features.name: Barbed Spear (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
features.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage and the target receives a dire wound if it doesn't have one. While the target is wounded, its speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it loses 5 (1d10) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to staunch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to Chakuna's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

features.name: Prowl (Panther or Hybrid Form Only)
features.text: Chakuna moves up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. At the end of this movement, she can take the Hide action.

features.name: Shape-Shift
features.text: Chakuna shape-shifts into a Large panther-humanoid hybrid or a Large panther, or she returns to her true humanoid form. Her game statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

features.name: Pounce
features.text: Chakuna moves up to half her Speed and makes one Scratch attack.

features.name: Strike from Shadows
features.text: Chakuna makes one Barbed Spear attack. If Chakuna has the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition. Chakuna can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

features.name: Sudden Bite
features.text: Chakuna uses Shape-Shift to turn into her hybrid form or panther form and then makes one Bite attack. Chakuna can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

features.name: Regional Effects
features.text:
Valachan is altered by Chakuna's presence, creating the following effects.

- **Closing the Borders.** While in her domain, Chakuna can close or open the borders to Valachan at will. While the borders are closed, shadowy beasts skulk or soar amid the Mists surrounding Valachan. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 1d10 Piercing damage.
- **Heightened Senses.** Beasts and Monstrosities have Advantage on Wisdom checks.
- **Whispering Shadows.** Humanoids subtract 1d8 from any ability checks they make when they take the Hide action.

If Chakuna dies, these effects end immediately.

features.name: Amphibious
features.text: Cthulhu can breathe air and water.

features.name: Darklord Restoration
features.text: If Cthulhu dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 weeks inside the Vault of Cthulhu.

features.name: Impossible Geometry
features.text: Ground, air, and water in a 10-foot Emanation originating from Cthulhu is Difficult Terrain. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.text: If Cthulhu fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.text: Cthulhu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Cthulhu makes three Eldritch Claw attacks and uses Spellcasting to cast Befuddlement if available or Mind Spike (level 4 version). It can replace one Eldritch Claw attack with a use of Tentacle.

features.name: Eldritch Claw
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d8 + 9) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) from one of two limbs.

features.name: Tentacle
features.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature Grappled by Cthulhu. Failure: 21 (6d6) Acid damage plus 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Psychic damage taken, and Cthulhu regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

features.name: Warp
features.text: Cthulhu teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet, taking creatures it is grappling with it. Then each creature within 10 feet of the space it left is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Clamp
features.text: Cthulhu makes an Eldritch Claw attack.

features.name: Fold Space
features.text: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 25, each creature and object that isn't being worn or carried in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point Cthulhu can see within 60 feet. Failure: 36 (8d8) Force damage, and the target is teleported to an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Cthulhu that is horizontal to it. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Cthulhu can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Regional Effects
features.text:
Innsmouth is altered by Cthulhu's presence, creating the following effects:

- **Choking Depths.** A creature can hold its breath for only 30 seconds while in the domain.
- **Closing the Borders.** While in its domain, Cthulhu can close or open the borders of Innsmouth at will. While the borders are closed, those who enter the Mists surrounding Innsmouth become lost at sea amid inky fog for 3d4 days before arriving once more at Innsmouth.
- **Something in the Air.** Creatures other than Cthulhu and its allies have Disadvantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

If Cthulhu dies, these effects end immediately.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text: Cthulhu casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25):

features.name: Flyby
features.text: The death's head doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

features.name: Bite
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

features.name: Overhanging Branches
features.text: The tree's allies can willingly end their moves in the tree's space. Allies in the tree's space have Half Cover.

features.name: Unholy Regrowth
features.text: If the tree dies, 2d6 Death's Head Trees regrow around the same place in 365 days unless the tree is killed by a creature under the effect of a Bless spell using a weapon that deals Slashing damage.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The tree makes two Slam attacks.

features.name: Slam
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Exploding Head
features.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the tree can see within 120 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and the creature has the Poisoned condition until the start of the tree's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Head Fruits
features.text: Each Undead ally in the tree's space can immediately take a Reaction to gain 5 Temporary Hit Points.

name: Dullahan
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

features.name: Mounted Adept
features.text: While mounted and without the Incapacitated condition, the dullahan and its mount have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and the dullahan can force an attack targeted at its mount to target the dullahan instead.

features.name: Terrorizer
features.text: The dullahan has Advantage on attack rolls against targets that have the Frightened condition.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The dullahan makes two attacks, using Beheading Blade or Fiery Skull in any combination, and uses Headless Wail.

features.name: Beheading Blade
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, it dies and its head is lopped off. The head rises as a Death's Head in the space of the target's corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The head is under the dullahan's control. The dullahan can control no more than seven heads at a time.

features.name: Fiery Skull
features.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Fire damage.

features.name: Headless Wail
features.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, up to three creatures within 120 feet of the dullahan that aren't Constructs or Undead. Failure: 13 (2d12) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the dullahan's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Darklord Restoration
features.text: If Ebonbane dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 weeks, teleporting somewhere in Shadowborn Manor. Until it revives, Ebonbane acts as a +3 Longsword when wielded by a creature.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.text: If Ebonbane fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.text: Ebonbane has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Ebonbane makes three Darkflame Slash attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Possess Dead if available.

features.name: Darkflame Slash
features.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

features.name: Possess Dead
features.text:
Ebonbane raises a Medium or Small Humanoid corpse within 5 feet of itself and possesses it. The corpse wields Ebonbane and is under its control. Ebonbane gains 50 Temporary Hit Points, and its statistics are the same, except its Speed increases to 30 feet, and it can speak through the corpse using any language the corpse knew in life.

The possession lasts until Ebonbane drops to 0 Hit Points or Ebonbane ends the possession as a Bonus Action. Once the possession ends, Ebonbane can't possess the corpse again. The corpse crumbles to dust 24 hours after the possession ends.

features.name: Worthy Wielder
features.text: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17, one willing Humanoid within 5 feet. Failure: 36 (8d8) Force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, Ebonbane devours its soul. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Ebonbane can be restored to life only by a Wish spell. Success: The target attunes to Ebonbane and can wield the sword.

features.name: Parry
features.text: Trigger: Ebonbane is hit by a melee attack roll. Response: Ebonbane adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

features.name: Retaliate
features.text: Ebonbane moves up to half its Speed and makes one Darkflame Slash attack.

features.name: Runic Flare
features.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature of Ebonbane's choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from Ebonbane. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. The target succeeds automatically after 1 minute. Failure or Success: Ebonbane can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Regional Effects
features.text:
The Shadowlands is altered by *Ebonbane*'s presence, creating the following effects:

- **Closing the Borders.** While in its domain, Ebonbane can close or open the borders of the Shadowlands at will. While the borders are closed, whirling blades of magic fly through the Mists surrounding the Shadowlands. A creature that enters the Mists for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 3d10 Force damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
- **Haunted Woods.** The forest within 1 mile of Ebonbane's lair is wreathed in a powerful illusion. Whenever a creature other than Ebonbane or the sword's allies finishes a Short or Long Rest in that area, it must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw, or it is lost in the forest, always finding itself at the location it started in until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.
- **Turning Weapons.** While in its lair, Ebonbane can transform nonmagical Greatswords and Longswords within 1 mile of the lair into Animated Flying Swords by completing a 24-hour ritual.

If *Ebonbane* is destroyed, these effects end immediately.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.text: The elder thing has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The elder thing makes two Soothing Tentacle attacks and uses Psychic Skewer.

features.name: Soothing Tentacle
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the elder thing's next turn.

features.name: Mind-Scouring Spores
features.text: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the elder thing. Failure: 55 (10d10) Psychic damage. For 1 minute, whenever the target takes the Magic action, it takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Psychic Skewer
features.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 60 feet. Failure: 22 (4d10) Psychic damage. If the target has the Charmed condition, it gains 1 Exhaustion level and has the Stunned condition while Charmed.

spellcasting.name: Eldritch Magic (3/Day)
spellcasting.text: The elder thing casts Command, Detect Thoughts, Gust of Wind, or Nondetection, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18).

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Ez makes three attacks, using Hunter's Blade or Fiery Bolt in any combination.

features.name: Hunter's Blade
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Radiant damage.

features.name: Fiery Bolt
features.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) Fire damage.

features.name: Bolster Allies
features.text: Ez chooses up to six allies within 60 feet. Each target that can hear her has Ez's choice of (A) Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn or (B) Resistance to Acid, Necrotic, and Poison damage until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Curse of the All-Seeing Eye
features.text:
Ez chooses a damage type. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one target within 30 feet that Ez can see. Failure: The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target has Vulnerability to the chosen damage type. The curse ends early if Ez uses this action again.

If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before the curse ends, Ez can take a Bonus Action on a later turn to curse a new creature.

features.name: Inspiring Rally
features.text: Ez chooses up to six allies within 60 feet. Each target that can hear her can take a Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text: Ez casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

spellcasting.name: Shield (3/Day)
spellcasting.text: Ez casts Shield in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

features.name: Aura of Violence

Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Wereraven under the DM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this wereraven's curse for 24 hours.

features.name: Scratch
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

features.name: Shortbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
features.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

features.name: Shape-Shift
features.text: The wereraven shape-shifts into a Medium raven-humanoid hybrid or a Small raven, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

features.name: Darklord Restoration
features.text: If Wilfred dies, he revives with all his Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Mordent.

features.name: Incorporeal Movement
features.text: Wilfred can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. He takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if he ends his turn inside an object.

damage.condition: if he ends his turn inside an object

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.text: If Wilfred fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Possessive Aura
features.text: Grasping, ghostly servants surround Wilfred in a 5-foot Emanation originating from him. A creature that ends its turn in this area is subjected to the following effect. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition. While the creature is Charmed in this way, its Speed is reduced to 0. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Wilfred makes two attacks, using Object Slam or Hunting Rifle in any combination.

features.name: Object Slam
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Force damage.

features.name: Hunting Rifle
features.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/120 ft. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) Necrotic damage.

features.name: Redirect Attack
features.text: Trigger: A creature Wilfred can see makes an attack roll against him. Response: Wilfred chooses a Small or Medium creature within 5 feet of himself that has the Charmed condition. Wilfred and that creature swap places, and the creature becomes the target of the attack instead.

features.name: Bone-Chilling Step
features.text: Wilfred teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space he left takes 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage. Wilfred can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

features.name: Fated Bullet
features.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature Wilfred can see within 120 feet. Failure: 16 (2d12 + 3) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the start of its next turn. Failure or Success: Wilfred can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

features.name: Slam
features.text: Wilfred makes one Object Slam attack.

features.name: Regional Effects
features.text:
Mordent is altered by Lord Godefroy's presence, creating the following effects:

- **Closing the Borders.** While in his domain, Lord Godefroy can close or open the borders to Mordent. While the borders are closed, the groans and whispers of the dead fill the Mists surrounding Mordent. Creatures in the Mists have the Deafened condition.
- **Ears Everywhere.** While in his domain, Lord Godefroy can cast Sending, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. When casting the spell in this way, Lord Godefroy can target any Undead creature in Mordent, in addition to the usual targets.
- **Spectral Serfs.** A Humanoid that dies in Mordent rises 7 days later as a Specter under Lord Godefroy's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life.

If Wilfred dies, these effects end immediately.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.text: The yithian has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Shielded Mind
features.text: The yithian's thoughts can't be read by any means, and other creatures can communicate with it telepathically only if it allows them.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The yithian makes three Pincer attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Sup.

features.name: Pincer
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage and the creature has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14).

features.name: Sup
features.text: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 10 feet that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 15 (3d6 + 5) Psychic damage. The target's Hit Points maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the yithian regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

features.name: Mind Swap
features.text:
Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 18, one Humanoid the yithian can see within 5 feet. Failure: The target is possessed by the yithian; the yithian disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The yithian now controls the body; the target has no awareness of the yithian's actions. The yithian can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect. The yithian's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's Speed and Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers. It knows everything the target knew.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the yithian leaves as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the yithian returns to its body, which appears within 5 feet of the target. The target is Stunned for 1 minute by alien memories, and it is immune to this yithian's Mind Swap for 24 hours. Success: The target is immune to Mind Swap for 24 hours.

spellcasting.name: Eldritch Magic (2/Day)
spellcasting.text: The yithian casts Clairvoyance, Modify Memory, Phantasmal Killer, or Transport via Plants, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18).

name: Zombie Clot
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

features.name: Deathly Stench
features.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the zombie. Failure: 9 (2d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Undead Fortitude
features.text: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The zombie makes two Slam attacks.

features.name: Slam
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Flesh Entomb
features.text:
Strength Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the zombie can see within 30 feet. Failure: 16 (3d10) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is entombed in a pile of dead flesh. While entombed, the target has the Restrained condition, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the dead flesh, and takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

The target can be freed if the dead flesh is destroyed (AC 10; HP 25; Immunity to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage).

name: Zombie Plague Spreader
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

features.name: Undead Fortitude
features.text: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

features.name: Viral Aura
features.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the zombie. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points. Success: The creature is immune to this zombie's Viral Aura for 24 hours.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The zombie makes two Slam attacks.

features.name: Slam
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

features.name: Virulent Miasma
features.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the zombie. Failure: 14 (4d6) Poison damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it dies and rises 1 minute later as a Zombie.
